item.title: Richard Gottehrer Accepts the Lifetime Award From Brad Navin | Indie Power Players 2026

[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to your daily briefing on what matters in the music industry. I'm your host, and I'll be bringing you the latest updates and insights from the world of music.
[Short pause]
Host: "Unfortunately, we don't have any specific news to share with you today, as our briefing is currently empty. But we invite you to sign up with your email address to stay up-to-date on the latest music industry news and trends.
[Outro music plays]
